digest.component_or_area: llm model building and fallback chain construction
propositions: A class with an unreachable primary model currently fails outright; a fallback array in the schema should allow inline model configs to fall back under specific error conditions.

The FallbackModel wrapper must be constructed with a fallback_on predicate that triggers only on errors where provider switching helps (RETRY_NOW, WAIT_AND_RETRY, CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL), not on auth/input errors where retrying elsewhere would also fail.

Fallback entries must preserve endpoint configuration so a local endpoint can back a hosted primary, and all sub-model clients must be entered/exited through the same ProviderSession to prevent double-close or leaks.

Capabilities must be computed as the conservative intersection across all candidate models (primary and fallbacks) before the wrapper is built, so unsupported features are withdrawn for the entire chain.
The ran_model field in verdicts must be sourced from the actual response (ModelResponse.model_name), not the synthetic FallbackModel.model_name, to correctly attest which candidate answered.
A plain 429 rate-limit must trigger fallback, but a 429 with insufficient_quota (classified as INCREASE_PROVIDER_LIMITS) must not, to avoid silently relocating spend to another provider.
